title: HUD receipt state could appear as native host acceptance
symptom: Independent review found that the compact Claude statusLine and Codex HUD rendered an unqualified session PASS from a recorded hook receipt while file verification and native host acceptance remained unverified. Long sessions, user-edited launcher ownership and repeated disable also had bounded-state gaps.

rootCause.summary: The compact renderer omitted evidence qualifiers, receipt scanning treated more than 256 entries as an error, Codex launcher ownership trusted only a header marker, and Claude disable required retained ownership state after manual statusLine removal. Receipt presence alone cannot prove native host delivery.

requestedOutcome: Keep receipt observation, file verification and native host acceptance visibly distinct; keep long-session scanning bounded; preserve user-edited host configuration; independently verify the fixes and then capture the same frozen current candidate in real Codex and Claude terminal hosts.
decisions: Treat recorded receipts as observation metadata, never native host-acceptance evidence.
Keep the issue in verifying state after static and focused-test closure until the frozen current candidate has native Codex and Claude evidence.
Use Sonnet for independent review and the user-selected GLM final audit instead of the earlier unexecuted Opus pass.

actions.description: Qualify compact HUD output, bound recent receipt selection, preserve edited Codex launchers and make absent Claude statusLine disable idempotent.
Run focused HUD tests and independent Sonnet fix verification.
Install the exact frozen current candidate in disposable profiles and capture native Codex and Claude HUD acceptance without borrowing the historical 0.2.3 result.

verification.name: Bounded HUD static and focused-test closure
verification.scope: Current product/hud collector, renderer and setup ownership behavior plus focused HUD launcher tests; no native host claim.
verification.result: The focused suite passed 21 tests with 149 assertions and no failures; safe-mode Sonnet fix verification returned PASS with no mandatory findings. Current native host acceptance was explicitly outside this result.

verification.name: Frozen current-candidate native HUD acceptance
verification.scope: Exact frozen candidate in disposable macOS Codex and Claude terminal profiles, including ready, not-ready, recovery, session scope and cleanup behavior.
verification.result: Rebuilt exact local archive c18a7da...fb84 installed both hosts, created the Codex launcher and Claude statusLine, and rendered both installed status entry points. Actual Codex PTY/tmux rendering and cleanup passed. Authenticated ready/error/recovery and Claude native UI remain pending: isolated profiles reached login flows. Windows packaged CLI installation and check/align/check passed separately; no native hook acceptance is claimed.

verification.name: GLM source audit and rebuilt artifact regression
verification.scope: HUD runtime sources, direct-entry guards and isolated installed status commands; not authenticated host event acceptance.
verification.result: GLM found no mandatory source defects. The original silent entry failure did not recur on the rebuilt archive; native session authentication remains an external prerequisite.

history.summary: Safe-mode Sonnet review returned FIX_REQUIRED because compact receipt PASS could be mistaken for file or native host acceptance and identified related bounded-state and ownership gaps.
The HUD now qualifies receipt state, bounds newest receipt validation, preserves edited launchers and makes absent statusLine disable idempotent.
Focused tests and independent static fix verification passed within their bounded scope; current-candidate native host acceptance remains pending.

Verified the rebuilt local archive entry points, qualified status and real Codex PTY rendering/cleanup. Native authenticated Codex/Claude transitions remain pending after disposable profiles reached login; the issue remains verifying.
